recap.analyst:
Ridgeview beat Lombardia Nord 2-0. On expected goals it finished 0.16–0.54: the scoreline flatters Ridgeview, who were second-best on chance quality.

Ridgeview had 53% of the ball. Pass completion RID 84% (165/196), LOM 85% (159/187). Shots 2–6, on target 2–0.

Ridgeview started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Lombardia Nord in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: LOM to 4-2-3-1 at 66' (chasing the game); RID to 5-4-1 at 80' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 42': Ridgeview broke the deadlock through P. Zorlav. Score now RID 1-0 LOM. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: I. Kawadate completed the most passes (37); T. Tamanari hit the top speed (33.3 km/h); A. Ndulagu covered the most ground (6.05 km, a 17 km per-90 pace); G. Okodele won the most challenges (12).

Discipline: fouls 2–5, yellows 0–1, offsides 0–0. Conditions: sunny, 29°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Castellana Arena, Madrid. P. Zorlav broke the deadlock in the 42nd minute. S. Laucourt struck in the 88th for Ridgeview. Lombardia Nord pushed for a way back, switching to a 4-2-3-1 in the 66th minute, but Ridgeview held firm. The hero: P. Zorlav, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Ridgeview celebrate in front of their fans.
